criterion: Vitest against the real database: a made-up camt.053 file and a made-up file for each of the five CSV formats import into the transaction store with amounts in öre, dates, counterparty, reference and the source batch
Importing the same file twice adds nothing and the batch lists what was skipped; a CSV without bank IDs de-duplicates on the hash
A file in no known format is refused with a plain Swedish message
Windows-1252, a BOM, a Unicode minus and a space thousand separator each parse correctly
Only a member with bank.manage can import; every member can list transactions
The test files hold no real person's or company's data (guards/synthetic-data.sh)
